what: An LLM-written expansion of Felucca with eight patterns per track, pattern chaining (up to 512 steps/pattern), per-step patch switching, multiple new chord modes, generative arpeggiator, new synth engines LEAD and SH-DRUM, borrowed engines SWARM, FM-TONE, and WAVETONE from Mini-Tone, new effects TAPE COMB and DJFX LOOP, and no samples.
author: echoe
